news.headline: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield hopes to play Sunday despite foot injury: 'I feel ready'
news.description: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is hoping to play Sunday against the Lions after he sustained a foot injury two weeks ago against the Chicago Bears.

news.headline: Hall of Famer Jack Ham returning to broadcast booth after health scare
news.description: Hall of Fame linebacker and Penn State radio analyst Jack Ham will return to the broadcast booth on Saturday, just two weeks after suffering a medical emergency.

news.headline: Vikings' Cousins channeling Dantonio's 'slow down' maxim amid whirlwind month
news.description: As he manages the whirlwind of his professional and personal life this month, Vikings QB Kirk Cousins has relied on a maxim he often heard from his college coach Mark Dantonio at Michigan State -- when things speed up, try to slow down.

news.headline: Studies: Blood test has potential to detect CTE in the living
news.description: A new blood test shows potential to detect advanced stages of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) in the living, according to two recent published studies.

transactions.text: Signed LB Joe Bachie from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed C Seth McLaughlin and RB Jabari Small to the practice squad. Placed G Mason Miller on the practice squad/injured list.

Signed OLs Devin Cochran and Mason Miller, WRs Malik Cunningham and Jackson Meeks, DE Ahmed Hassanein, TE Zach Horton, RB Jabari Small, DL Chris Smith and S Loren Strickland to reserve/futures contracts. Re-signed OL Michael Niese, RB Jacob Saylors and CB Nick Whiteside.

insights: 2026 cap number of $248K is the 67th-largest on the roster.
Entered the league in 2025 as an undrafted free agent.
